name: viral-shorts-factory
description: AI-assisted YouTube Shorts production pipeline (internal tool)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vsf/contracts && npm run build -w @vsf/api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @vsf/api && npm run lint -w web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @vsf/api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @vsf/api && npm run test -w web -- --watch=false
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:e2e -w @vsf/api
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml up -d --wait postgres redis storage
